item.title: University of Washington wrong to punish professor for parodying school policy: appeals court
item.description: A University of Washington professor cannot be punished for making fun of a school policy in his syllabus, an appeals court panel has ruled. #StuartReges #UniversityofWashington #FirstAmendment #FIRE #NativeAmericans #students #appealscourt

item.title: Arizona man threatened with arrest after sharing Christian beliefs at Christmas festival: attorneys
item.description: Arizona city officials allegedly threatened a local resident with arrest after he and a group of friends attempted to share their Christian beliefs during a Christmas festival, which First Liberty Institute says infringed on the man’s right to religious expression. #Christmasfestival #FirstAmendment #religiousfreedom #freespeech #CityofTucson

item.title: 5 Christians sentenced to combined 50 years in Iranian prison: advocacy orgs
item.description: Five Iranian Christians have been sentenced to a combined 50 years in prison for religious activities, including prayer, baptism and distributing Bibles, according to watchdog organizations. #IranianChristians #ArrestedforFaith #ChristianPersecution #Prayer #Baptism #BiblesDistribution #UnitedStates #ReligiousFreedom #Iran

item.title: 'A declaration of vengeance': US strikes ISIS targets in Syria after 3 Americans were killed
item.description: The United States launched military strikes on Islamic State targets in Syria on Friday in response to the killing of three Americans during a counterterrorism operation. The offensive aimed to destroy IS (also known as ISIS) infrastructure believed to be linked to the Dec. 13 attack. #IslamicState #ISIS #Terror #Counterterrorism #PresidentAhmedalSharaa

item.title: Misconduct lawsuit against New York City church dismissed following investigation
item.description: A complainant has dropped a lawsuit filed against a New York City church over allegations of abuse and failure to properly respond to the accusations after a third-party investigation could not substantiate the claims. #EpiscopalChurch #abuse #misconduct #StThomas #church #NewYork

item.title: US to boost Christian hospitals in Nigeria amid efforts to protect believers from violence
item.description: The United States has signed a $5.1 billion five-year bilateral health agreement with Nigeria, directing substantial new funding toward Christian faith-based healthcare providers in an effort to expand health services and protect vulnerable Christian populations. The move marks a new phase in U.S.-Nigeria cooperation under the America First Global Health Strategy. #Nigeria #ChristianPersecution #UnitedStates #PresidentTrump #BokoHaram #Fulani #Healthcare #Tuberculosis #AmericaFirstGlobalHealthSt

item.title: Former police officer arrested for sharing meme after Charlie Kirk shooting sues sheriff
item.description: A retired police officer who spent 37 days in jail after posting a meme on Facebook about the assassination of conservative activist Charlie Kirk filed a federal civil rights lawsuit against a Tennessee sheriff and his county. #CharlieKirk #Meme #FreeSpeech

item.title: Nicki Minaj says she's reignited her relationship with God: 'Where've you been?'
item.description: Rapper Nicki Minaj opened up about her recently reignited relationship with God and what inspired her to speak out for persecuted Christians, suggesting that her rise in the music industry made it more challenging to maintain the spirituality of her youth. #NickiMinaj #ErikaKirk #TPUSA #Amfest #Christianfaith

item.title: Doug Wilson rebukes 'unhinged' Candace Owens, explains Christian views on Israel
item.description: The Rev. Douglas Wilson, who serves as senior pastor at Christ Church (CREC) in Moscow, Idaho, condemned conservative podcaster Candace Owens during Turning Point USA's AmericaFest in Phoenix, Arizona, last week, and explained the various Christian schools of thought regarding modern Israel. #DouglasWilson #SteveDeace #Israel #AmFest #TurningPointUSA #dispensationalism #EndTimes

item.title: Pastors urged to carry on Charlie Kirk's 'torch' and preach against abortion
item.description: A new coalition letter backed by notable Christian conservatives is urging pastors to speak clearly on abortion and the sacredness of unborn lives, especially at a time when churches are experiencing a reported uptick in attendance following Charlie Kirk’s assassination. #prolifemovement #churchattendance #Christianfaith #CharlieKirkremembrance #WordofGod
